body:
Required release Engine Focus (100 projects, 10k cards, 50k note reports) improves all-read median from 52.8-53.2 to 30.5 ms and p95 from 57.6-58.3 to 31.2 ms. A concentrated 50k-note index comparison improves the Rust no-receipt path from about 58 to 2 ms; the final concentrated build measures 2.0/6.8/14.7 ms median across zero/half/all receipt profiles. Each final profile has 200 samples after 20 warm calls. Mixed histories retain 30-39 ms medians.

Receipts remain durable journal state; lazy request-local Rust membership and an ordered disposable index preserve scope, cursors, decisions and source versions. The full gate passes 269 Rust, 139 JavaScript and 12 Python tests; Focus/protocol pass in Chromium and WebKit. The rebuilt manual app preserves all 57 prior source versions, pins, preferences and certificate; trusted HTTPS and all 33 assets are verified.

Evidence: progress/2026-09-30-focus-rust-receipts.md. Measurements exclude transport/browser costs. Dense Calendar, broader profiles, write pauses and physical-device/full release acceptance remain open.

metadata.summary: Verified Rust receipt membership and ordered unread reads speed up large Focus histories.
